units.source_text: 夕雾升官之后，威势日盛，寄居岳父邸内，颇感房室狭隘，

en.t: After Yugiri was promoted, his power and prestige grew day by day; while staying in his father-in-law's residence, he felt the rooms were rather cramped,

units.source_text: 便迁居以前太君所居的三条院中。

en.t: so he moved into Sanjo-in, where the Grand Lady had formerly lived.

units.source_text: 太君逝世之后，院宇略见荒芜。

en.t: After the Grand Lady passed away, the mansion had become somewhat neglected.

units.source_text: 此次大加修理，并改变太君当年的布置，然后迁入。

en.t: This time he had it extensively repaired, changed the arrangements from the Grand Lady's day, and then moved in.

units.source_text: 夕雾与云居雁居此邸内，回想以前初恋时情状，触景生情，不胜感慨。

en.t: Living there with Kumoinokari, Yugiri recalled the days of their first love, and the scene stirred such memories that he was deeply moved.

units.source_text: 庭前各种树木，当年还很幼小，今已绿叶成荫，异常繁荣。

en.t: The various trees in the garden, still young in those days, were now lush with green leaves and cast abundant shade.

units.source_text: 当年所植的“一丛芭芒草”，任意蔓延，乱侵阶除，便命人加以删整。

en.t: The clump of pampas grass planted back then had spread unchecked and encroached wildly on the steps, so he ordered it cut back and tidied.

units.source_text: 庭中的池水里长满了水草，便命人清除。

en.t: Water weeds had filled the pond in the garden, so he ordered them cleared away.

units.source_text: 于是庭中景色，焕然一新。

en.t: Thus the garden scenery was transformed and looked fresh again.

units.source_text: 夫妇二人共赏夕暮美景，闲话童年初恋时好事多磨之恨，云居雁不胜依恋。

en.t: The couple admired the beautiful evening view together and spoke idly of the frustrations and obstacles of their childhood first love; Kumoinokari was overcome with tender attachment.

units.source_text: 回想当时旁人作何感想，又颇感羞惭。

en.t: Remembering what others must have thought at the time, she also felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 当年太君身边的侍女，都不曾散去，照旧住在各人的房间里。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting who had served the Grand Lady in those days had never dispersed, but still lived in their own rooms as before.

units.source_text: 她们齐来参见这一对新夫妇，皆大欢喜。

en.t: They all came together to pay their respects to the newly settled couple, and everyone was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 夕雾怀念外祖母，即景吟诗云：

en.t: Missing his maternal grandmother, Yugiri composed a poem inspired by the scene:
